items.description: The full source of one method.

source.description: The full method source to compile, selector line included, or several method sources for the same class.

class.description: The class to compile the method into.

force.description: Continue through refactoring warnings instead of stopping, and compile over a method the class got from a trait, overriding it in this class.

protocol.description: The protocol to file the method under. Omitted, a method being replaced keeps the protocol it is in, and a new one is left unclassified, which the answer warns about. For an extension method, name an extension protocol such as *Package-Name.
